channel.title: Copied Updates
channel.description: Updates for the direct-download edition of Copied.

item.title: Copied 1.3.3 (18)
item.description:
Copied 1.3.3

  • Removes the Accessibility permission request. Global shortcuts now register without privileged keyboard access.
  • Copies paste-queue items without simulating keyboard input.
  • Adds About Copied to the popover, status-item menu, and application menu.
  • Shows update-check progress and results in About settings.
  • Adds background Homebrew update checks and installation through Terminal, with a copyable upgrade command.
  • Fixes copying the selected clipping with Command+C, Control+C, and Edit > Copy in the main window.
  • Adds secure automatic update checks for direct downloads.
  • Improves clipboard reliability and image handling.
  • Improves background synchronization from the iOS share extension.
